listing.name: Wild 9 (Wild9Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official portable Windows/Linux/macOS runtime archives; user provides original NTSC-U SLUS-00425 data via upstream flow. Current README explicitly requires no compiler/Python/MSVC for player packages. Limits: NTSC-U SLUS-00425. Recent packages and checksum sidecars exist; reuse PSX family route. Upstream platforms: Portable Windows x86-64 ZIP, Linux x86-64 ZIP/AppImage, macOS x86-64 and ARM64 ZIPs; Linux glibc2.28+. Player packages need no compiler/Python/MSVC. Original data: Own Wild 9 NTSC-U/USA PS1 disc SLUS-00425 as CUE with its companion BIN track data. Upstream uses boot executable SLUS_004.25 and the remaining disc content. Player runtime includes OpenBIOS; Sony SCPH BIOS is optional, not required. Current portable releases require no Python/MSVC/compiler. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
